audience: on-call engineers and DevOps teams who ship from GitHub and watch errors in Sentry and incidents in PagerDuty

useCases.title: Find what broke since the last deploy
useCases.text: The AI finds the latest GitHub deployment or release of a repo, lists the unresolved Sentry issues since that time, and names who is on call in PagerDuty.

useCases.title: Get a snapshot of what is on fire now
useCases.text: The AI combines the top unresolved Sentry issues, the triggered and acknowledged PagerDuty incidents and the current on-call person into one short summary.

useCases.title: Prepare an on-call handoff briefing
useCases.text: The AI shows who is on call, the active incidents they inherit, what is live from the latest GitHub deploy and the top Sentry errors. It warns when a fresh deploy and active incidents come at the same time.

useCases.title: Check when the latest deploy went out
useCases.text: The AI reads the latest GitHub deployment of a repo, or the latest release if there is none, with its commit sha and time.

useCases.title: List recent unresolved Sentry issues
useCases.text: The AI lists the unresolved issues of a Sentry project in a recent time window, so you can see which errors are new or still open.
